title: Harbison Protection Contracts: Refrigerant, Leak Search, Diagnostic and After-Hours Coverage by Tier
content:
Beyond labor and parts, a service invoice can carry refrigerant, a refrigerant leak search, the visit's diagnostic fee and an after-hours premium. This schedule records, tier by tier, which of these items a Harbison Protection Contracts tier covers and how many pounds of refrigerant one claim may be paid for.

| Tier | Refrigerant covered | Most refrigerant paid per claim | Leak search covered | Diagnostic fee covered | After-hours premium covered |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty | no | 0 lb | no | yes | no |
| Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection | no | 0 lb | no | no | no |
| Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection | no | 0 lb | no | no | no |
| Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection | no | 0 lb | yes | yes | no |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection | yes | 6 lb | yes | yes | yes |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus | yes | 10 lb | yes | yes | yes |

**What each column means.**

- *Refrigerant covered*: whether refrigerant added during a covered repair is paid.
- *Most refrigerant paid per claim*: the most pounds of refrigerant paid on one claim.
- *Leak search covered*: whether the refrigerant leak search task is paid on a covered refrigerant-circuit failure.
- *Diagnostic fee covered*: whether the diagnostic fee of the visit on which a covered failure was diagnosed is paid.
- *After-hours premium covered*: whether the after-hours premium of that visit is paid.

**Reading across the tiers (hypothetical illustrations).**

- The Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection covers the leak search but not refrigerant itself, so its refrigerant pound figure is 0.
- The two 12-year tiers are the only tiers covering the after-hours premium; they differ in the refrigerant pound figure, 6 lb against 10 lb.
- The Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty covers the diagnostic fee; the two labor-only tiers, the Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection and the Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection, do not.
